children: Eurozone bond yields rise, adding to previous increases, after the release of flash estimate eurozone inflation data for August. Headline annual CPI rose to 3.3% in August, from 2.9% in July, albeit in line with analyst expectations in The Wall Street Journal's poll. The 10-year German Bund yield hits a new 15-year high of 3.364%. It last trades at 3.362%, up 4.8 basis points, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
